newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Four die in Russia after trains hit truck.
newsitem.headline: Four die in Russia after trains hit truck.

text.p: Four people died after two passenger trains hit a truck on a railway crossing near the Siberian town of Novosibirsk, Russia's emergencies' ministry said on Saturday.
The truck driver and two rail passengers were killed instantly after the first train ploughed into the vehicle.
Another train hit the truck shortly afterwards and an assistant engine driver later died in hospital from his injuries, a ministry spokesman said.
